cat > /app/output/gen.py <<'PY'
"""Vision-guided controller used for the live RoboCasa365 faucet episode.

Only RGB-D camera frames/calibration and robot proprioception are used. The
lever is localized from its visible red pixels in the left agent camera; depth
back-projection gives a world-frame contact point. Small measured pose Jacobians
then drive the gripper toward the point while preserving its initial orientation.
"""
import sys, argparse
import numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
from rcb_client import Robot

CAM = "robot0_agentview_left"
EYE = "robot0_eye_in_hand"
CAMERAS = [CAM, EYE]
# Franka Panda joint travel limits (radians), used only to keep commands feasible.
Q_LO = np.array([-2.8973, -1.7628, -2.8973, -3.0718, -2.8973, -0.0175, -2.8973])
Q_HI = np.array([ 2.8973,  1.7628,  2.8973, -0.0698,  2.8973,  3.7525,  2.8973])

def pose_and_q(obs):
    p = obs.meta["proprio"]
    names = p["layout"]
    v = np.asarray(p["now"], dtype=float)
    q = np.array([v[names.index(f"robot0_joint{i}_pos")] for i in range(1, 8)])
    ee = v[[names.index("eef_right_x"), names.index("eef_right_y"), names.index("eef_right_z")]]
    return q, ee

def cam_rotation(obs, cam=EYE):
    return np.asarray(obs.meta["cameras"][cam]["cam2world_gl"], dtype=float)[:3, :3]

def rotvec(R):
    """Axis-angle vector of a near-identity rotation matrix."""
    c = np.clip((np.trace(R)-1.0)/2.0, -1.0, 1.0)
    a = np.arccos(c)
    v = np.array([R[2,1]-R[1,2], R[0,2]-R[2,0], R[1,0]-R[0,1]])
    if a < 1e-7:
        return 0.5*v
    return (a/(2.0*np.sin(a)))*v

def action(q, grip=-1., base=(0., 0., 0.), torso=0., mode=-1.):
    return np.r_[q, grip, base, torso, mode]

def run_path(robot, q0, q1, n=18, grip=-1., cameras=CAMERAS, include_depth=True):
    # Smooth position targets across the chunk rather than issuing a single jump.
    rows = [action(q, grip) for q in np.linspace(q0, q1, n)]
    return robot.submit("joint_position", np.asarray(rows), interpolate="hold",
                        cameras=cameras, include_depth=include_depth, video="none")

def point_from_pixel(obs, x, y, cam=CAM):
    calib = obs.meta["cameras"][cam]
    K = np.asarray(calib["intrinsic_cv"], dtype=float)
    T = np.asarray(calib["cam2world_gl"], dtype=float)
    d = float(obs.depth[cam][0, y, x])
    # Depth is camera-forward distance; OpenGL camera coordinates look down -z.
    pc = np.array([(x-K[0,2])*d/K[0,0], -(y-K[1,2])*d/K[1,1], -d, 1.0])
    return (T @ pc)[:3]

def find_handle(obs):
    """Find the faucet's small red lever in the visible faucet ROI and back-project it."""
    rgb = obs.last[CAM]
    dep = obs.depth[CAM][0]
    calib = obs.meta["cameras"][CAM]
    K = np.asarray(calib["intrinsic_cv"], dtype=float)
    T = np.asarray(calib["cam2world_gl"], dtype=float)
    pts = []
    # In this scene view the lever occupies x=170..176, y=105..117. Color is
    # selected from the image; each selected pixel is independently depth-lifted.
    for y in range(105, 118):
        for x in range(170, 177):
            R, G, B = map(int, rgb[y, x])
            if R > 1.3*G and R > 1.3*B and R < 220 and G < 160 and dep[y, x] > 0:
                d = float(dep[y, x])
                pc = np.array([(x-K[0,2])*d/K[0,0], -(y-K[1,2])*d/K[1,1], -d, 1.0])
                pts.append((T @ pc)[:3])
    if len(pts) < 5:
        raise RuntimeError(f"faucet lever was not visible in RGB-D ROI ({len(pts)} pixels)")
    return np.median(np.asarray(pts), axis=0), len(pts)

def calibrate_jacobian(robot, q, ee, R, grip=-1., eps=0.04, n=10):
    """Measure end-effector translational and angular motion per joint radian."""
    J = np.zeros((6, 7))
    for j in range(7):
        qt = q.copy(); qt[j] = np.clip(qt[j]+eps, Q_LO[j]+0.01, Q_HI[j]-0.01)
        de = qt[j]-q[j]
        res = run_path(robot, q, qt, n=n, grip=grip, cameras=[EYE], include_depth=False)
        _, p1 = pose_and_q(res)
        R1 = cam_rotation(res)
        J[:3, j] = (p1-ee)/de
        J[3:, j] = rotvec(R1 @ R.T)/de
        # Restore the measured posture before probing the next axis.
        res = run_path(robot, pose_and_q(res)[0], q, n=n, grip=grip,
                       cameras=[EYE], include_depth=False)
        print(f"jacobian joint {j+1}: {J[:,j].round(3).tolist()}")
    return J

def move_pose(robot, target, Rgoal, obs, grip=-1., max_iters=18):
    q, ee = pose_and_q(obs)
    R = cam_rotation(obs)
    J = calibrate_jacobian(robot, q, ee, R, grip=grip)
    for it in range(max_iters):
        q, ee = pose_and_q(obs)
        R = cam_rotation(obs)
        err = np.r_[target-ee, rotvec(Rgoal @ R.T)]
        ep, er = np.linalg.norm(err[:3]), np.linalg.norm(err[3:])
        print(f"move {it}: position error {ep:.3f} m, orientation error {er:.3f} rad, ee {ee.round(3).tolist()}")
        if ep < 0.012 and er < 0.07:
            break
        # Damped least squares handles the redundant 7-joint pose task smoothly.
        lam = 0.025
        dq = J.T @ np.linalg.solve(J @ J.T + lam*lam*np.eye(6), err)
        dn = np.linalg.norm(dq)
        if dn > 0.24:
            dq *= 0.24/dn
        qnext = np.clip(q+dq, Q_LO+0.01, Q_HI-0.01)
        if np.linalg.norm(qnext-q) < 0.006:
            print("joint limits prevent further progress")
            break
        res = run_path(robot, q, qnext, n=18, grip=grip, cameras=CAMERAS, include_depth=True)
        obs = res
        # Re-measure locally while well clear of the faucet. Near contact we
        # retain the last safe Jacobian so the probe cannot bump the lever.
        if np.linalg.norm(target-pose_and_q(obs)[1]) > 0.075 and it+1 < max_iters:
            q, ee = pose_and_q(obs); R = cam_rotation(obs)
            J = calibrate_jacobian(robot, q, ee, R, grip=grip)
    return obs

def save_last(obs, prefix):
    from PIL import Image
    for cam, im in obs.last.items():
        Image.fromarray(im).save(f"/app/output/{prefix}_{cam}.png")

def main(phase="all"):
    r = Robot()
    obs = r.get_obs(cameras=CAMERAS, include_depth=True, video="none")
    q, ee = pose_and_q(obs)
    lever, npx = find_handle(obs)
    Rgoal = cam_rotation(obs)
    print("start q", q.round(3).tolist(), "ee", ee.round(3).tolist())
    print("RGB-D lever", lever.round(4).tolist(), "selected pixels", npx,
          "time left", round(obs.meta["time_left_s"], 1))
    if phase in ("all", "hover"):
        hover = lever + np.array([0.0, 0.0, 0.16])
        obs = move_pose(r, hover, Rgoal, obs, grip=-1.)
        save_last(obs, "hover")
        print("hover complete", pose_and_q(obs)[1].round(4).tolist(), "time left", obs.meta["time_left_s"])
        if phase == "hover": return
    if phase in ("all", "engage"):
        # Move the open gripper to the visible lever center and close around it.
        contact, npx2 = find_handle(obs)
        print("contact target", contact.round(4).tolist(), "pixels", npx2)
        obs = move_pose(r, contact, Rgoal, obs, grip=-1.)
        q, _ = pose_and_q(obs)
        res = run_path(r, q, q, n=15, grip=1., cameras=CAMERAS, include_depth=True)
        obs = res
        save_last(obs, "grasp")
        print("gripper closed", pose_and_q(obs)[1].round(4).tolist(), "time left", obs.meta["time_left_s"])
        if phase == "engage": return
    if phase in ("all", "turn"):
        # Turn by wrist roll around the near-vertical tool axis in small steps;
        # inspect the handle after each step and retain a firm closed grip.
        q, _ = pose_and_q(obs)
        for k, dq7 in enumerate([-0.18, -0.18, -0.18, 0.18, 0.18, 0.18]):
            qnext = q.copy(); qnext[6] = np.clip(qnext[6]+dq7, Q_LO[6]+0.02, Q_HI[6]-0.02)
            obs = run_path(r, q, qnext, n=12, grip=1., cameras=CAMERAS, include_depth=True)
            q, _ = pose_and_q(obs)
            save_last(obs, f"turn_{k}")
            print("turn increment", dq7, "q7", round(float(q[6]),3), "left", obs.meta["time_left_s"])
        # End with the last executed state held; do not submit anything further.
        print("final status", r.status())

if __name__ == "__main__":
